facts.fact: CIO Africa reports Kenya's National Cybersecurity Agency was established by the National Cybersecurity Agency Order, 2026 (Legal Notice No. 89), made by President Ruto under the State Corporations Act, and has existed since July.
CIO Africa reports the National KE-CIRT/CC, Kenya's incident response team, issued 20.7 million advisories between April and June 2026.
CIO Africa reports the National KE-CIRT/CC detected just under 2.36 billion cyber threat events between April and June 2026.

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior and National Administration

facts.fact: CIO Africa reports the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, 2018 established the National Computer and Cybercrimes Coordination Committee (NC4), and that an amendment to it has not yet been passed.
